name: Heinz Original Tomato Ketchup (Smooth Mild Condiment)
whyItWorks: Smooth, concentrated tomato paste cooked with vinegar, corn syrup, salt, and onion powder. It has zero seeds and zero tomato skins. Safe in remission in 1-tablespoon servings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip baked potato fries or chicken tenders lightly. Avoid drowning foods in ketchup during flares.
watchOuts: Contains natural tomato acid, onion powder, and high-fructose corn syrup; avoid in acute gastritis or active flare-ups.
